title: Stage E · actor Lipschitz (exploratory)
note: Spectral norm of ∂a/∂s over the plant observation, at the 4000 states of 20 deterministic battery episodes per checkpoint (TRM via its untruncated forward). 72 Phase 3 Stage 1 checkpoints, 12 per trunk; medians per trunk. Noise drop = nominal IQM − IQM at σ = 0.05. Spearman ρ, Lipschitz vs reversals: −0.24 all, −0.59 MLP, −0.40 TRM; vs noise drop: +0.06, +0.18, +0.23. Source: analysis_p4_e.json.
